1.1IntroductionMicrosoftCopilot
Introduction · why it matters

Copilot for you and your team — from hype to help

Frontier Firms aren’t the ones running the most AI pilots. They redesign work so that people set the direction and agents take on more of the execution.

What you hear vs. what the data says

Flip the switch to replace each claim with the evidence.

“AI will replace our people.”
86%of AI users treat AI output as a starting point, not an answer — people stay responsible for the thinking.
Flip to Help →
“Just give people the AI tool — they'll figure out what to do.”
36%of employees feel properly trained in AI — and culture, managers and talent practices drive 2× the AI impact of individual effort.AI is a skill to be trained and a culture to be nurtured.
Flip to Help →
“AI is an IT project.”
+17 ptsin recognised AI value when managers actively model AI use. Yet only 1 in 4 workers see clear leadership alignment on AI.
Flip to Help →
Journey to the Frontier FirmNot a straight line — most organisations work in all three phases at once.
Phase 1

Human with assistant

Every employee has an AI assistant that helps them work better and faster.

At ADARO · a division head prepares Monday's management meeting from mail, Teams and files in minutes, not hours.
CopilotWork IQ
Phase 2

Human-agent teams

Agents join teams as digital colleagues, taking on specific tasks at human direction.

At ADARO · Researcher builds a cited benchmark, Analyst works through the production workbooks and Cowork assembles the weekly review pack.
CoworkResearcherAnalystCustom agents
Phase 3

Human-led, agent-operated

People set the direction; agents run whole processes and workflows, checking in as needed.

At ADARO · an always-on Autopilot keeps the Pit B production recovery plan moving — following up, flagging risks and asking before anything consequential.
AutopilotRolling out to Frontier
Your role in this room

2 · Align itAgree two or three priority workflows per function, and say it the same way.
3 · Redesign one workflowPick one recurring report and hand it to an agent or to Cowork.

1.2IntroductionMicrosoftCopilot
Introduction · who needs which Copilot

AI user profiles — Basic, Intermediate, Advanced

ADARO leaders will have a mix of licenses. Start everyone at Basic, license Intermediate by use case, and fund Advanced by the outcome it delivers.

For leaders
  • Start everyone at Basic.
  • License Intermediate by use case.
  • Fund Advanced by the outcome it delivers.
1
Level 1

Basic

Copilot Chat (Basic)

Who: new or occasional AI users — the starting point for every ADARO employee on an eligible Microsoft 365 plan.

  • Rewrite a memo or safety bulletin
  • Summarize an uploaded SOP
  • Web research on a technical topic, with sources
  • Approved agents from the store
Move up when they use AI on most working days and have a use case that needs their own work data.
2
Level 2

Intermediate

Microsoft Copilot (Premium) · USL

Who: leaders and knowledge workers whose work lives in email, meetings, Teams and Office files.

  • Prepare a management meeting with Work IQ
  • Work collaboratively and natively with Copilot in Office applications (Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, SharePoint)
  • Teams meeting recap, inbox catch-up and drafted replies
  • Production-report analysis with Analyst; deep research with Researcher
  • Custom agents in Agent Builder on the team's own knowledge
  • Copilot connectors to other systems and Power BI via Fabric IQ — needs this license, IT approval and data access
Move up when they have repeatable multi-step work with a measurable time saving.
3
Level 3

Advanced

USL+ Copilot Credits · Cowork

Who: people who hand off whole outcomes rather than single prompts.

  • Weekly production & hauling review delegated to Cowork
  • Recurring report packs that run on a schedule
  • Preparation packs for management meetings
  • A dashboard, a Word summary and a draft email from one brief
  • Connectors also work inside Cowork and agents; a Fabric data agent on Power BI data needs F2+ or P1+ capacity
Needs a Copilot Credits spending policy that selects Cowork — the policy is an access control, not just a budget.
IncludedEligible Microsoft 365 subscription · no add-on
Fixed per user per monthMicrosoft Copilot license (USL)
USL + Copilot Credits per taskUsage-based billing (UBB)

1.3IntroductionMicrosoftCopilot
Copilot foundations

What is Copilot — model, grounding and surfaces

Five building blocks sit behind every answer: your everyday apps take your ask, the Copilot orchestrator grounds it in your work through Work IQ and in current facts through web grounding, and a large language model reasons and writes the answer.

Microsoft CopilotHow an answer is made
1Ask2Ground3Ground4Prompt5Draft6Reply
Where it livesThe orchestratorThe engineGroundingThe answerSelect a box to see what it does
1
Your everyday appsWhere it lives

You ask Copilot where you already work: copilot.cloud.microsoft, the Copilot app, Teams and Outlook — and, with Microsoft Copilot (Premium), inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

ExampleIn the Copilot app: “Summarize this shift handover report and list the open safety actions.”

2
Copilot orchestratorThe coordinator

Coordinates the language model, your context and the tools. It reads your prompt, gets grounding from Work IQ and the web, sends a grounded prompt to the model, and checks the response before you see it.

ExampleIt finds the handover report you can open, adds it to your prompt, and sends both to the model.

3
A large language modelThe engine

Reads the grounded prompt and writes the draft. Copilot can use more than one model — leave it on Auto and Copilot picks the model for the task (see Choosing your model in Chat). Your prompts and work data are not used to train the foundation models.

ExampleIt reads the handover report, then drafts the summary and the list of actions.

4
Work IQGrounding in your work
Premium

Grounds the answer in your work — email, chats, meetings and files in OneDrive and SharePoint — through Microsoft Graph. It only reads content you already have permission to open. With Copilot Chat (Basic), you bring work content in by attaching files (see Bringing your files into Chat).

Example“What did we agree in last week’s plant meeting?” — Copilot finds the meeting recap and the follow-up email.

5
Web groundingGrounding in the web
BasicPremium

When web search is on, Copilot sends a short search query to Bing — not your whole prompt or your files — and uses the results for current facts, with citations.

Example“Summarize recent public news about heavy-equipment electrification.”

6
An answer you can useThe answer

The answer comes back where you work, with citations you can open to check the source. You stay in charge: review it, edit it, then use it.

ExampleA five-bullet summary, with links to the pages of the report it used.

In a nutshell

Microsoft Copilot = in-app experience + Copilot orchestrator + LLM + Work IQ + web grounding. Your prompt goes in, the orchestrator grounds it in your data and the web, the model writes the draft, and the answer comes back where you work — inside ADARO’s Microsoft 365 security boundary.

Sources · Microsoft Copilot overview — Microsoft Learn · Overview of the Copilot orchestrator — Microsoft Learn · How does Microsoft Copilot work? — Microsoft Learn

BasicPremium

You can choose which AI model answers your prompt. On Copilot Chat (Basic), leave it on Auto — Copilot picks the best model for the task — or choose Quick response or Think deeper. 2.4Copilot foundationsMicrosoftCopilot
Copilot foundations

Bringing your files into Chat

Three ways to put OneDrive, SharePoint and device files in front of Copilot.

Type / to reference

Type a forward slash in the prompt box to pick files already in OneDrive or SharePoint. Copilot suggests recent files — keep typing to filter.

Attach cloud files

Select the Attach cloud files icon to browse OneDrive and SharePoint in a pop-up — attach a single file or a whole folder.

Upload files

Select + in the prompt box to add files from your device. A copy is saved to your OneDrive.

Limits. Upload up to 20 files per conversation, 50 MB each. Without Microsoft Copilot (Premium) — or with Work IQ off — the / menu offers files only; people, meetings, emails and chats need Premium with Work IQ on.

Prompt · copy and paste

Prompting like a pro — build a prompt from four ingredients

A prompt is how you ask Copilot to create, summarize, edit, transform or catch you up — in plain language, with enough context to do the job well.

The strongest prompts include four things — Goal, Context, Source and Expectations. Click a card to add its part to the prompt; click it again to take it out.

CreateSummarizeEditTransformCatch upLearn
Microsoft CopilotYour prompt
Click an ingredient card above to add its part of the prompt here.Prepare talking points for Monday’s site coordination meeting. I will report the status of the fleet maintenance program and its main risks to the Operations Director in 10 minutes. Use /[Fleet-Availability-Tracker.xlsx] and my emails and Teams chats with the Plant team since 1 November. Give at most 5 points, then a risk table with owner and due date.
GoalContextSourceExpectations

Ringkas /SOP Permit to Work Rev.3.pdf menjadi 10 poin untuk safety briefing pagi kru tambang, dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami pekerja lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Mine Planning Engineer
Bandingkan /Laporan Produksi Harian 8 Nov.xlsx dengan /Laporan Produksi Harian 9 Nov.xlsx. Tampilkan 5 pit dengan penurunan terbesar dan pertanyaan yang perlu saya ajukan ke tim lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Maintenance Engineer · web
Cari praktik terbaik global untuk menurunkan konsumsi bahan bakar armada hauling di tambang batu bara terbuka. Sertakan sumber dan buat ringkasan satu halaman.
Dengan Work IQ ·Mine Operations Head
Siapkan bahan morning meeting saya besok: agenda dari undangan kalender, isu produksi dan HSE yang dibahas di Teams hari ini, dan email penting yang belum saya balas.
Dengan Work IQ ·Project Owner
Rangkum perkembangan program pengupasan overburden minggu ini dari email, chat Teams, dan notulen rapat — keputusan apa yang sudah diambil, siapa PIC-nya, dan apa yang masih tertunda?
Dengan Work IQ ·SCM · Contract Owner
Dari rapat dan email dengan [kontraktor tambang] bulan ini, apa saja tindak lanjut yang saya janjikan dan mana yang belum selesai?

Notice the pattern. Each prompt starts with you supplying the material — attaching a file with /, or asking the web. Copilot is capable, but it starts from zero every time.

The prompt gets shorter, and the question gets bigger. You stop describing the material and ask about your actual work — your meetings, mail, chats and files are already in context.

Work IQ is part of Microsoft IQ — the intelligence platform that also brings Fabric IQ (Power BI and Fabric data), Foundry IQ and Web IQ. For ADARO, Fabric data in Microsoft Copilot is the path to Power BI production reports.

Say it once as an agent — then just ask “Recap my week.”

The long prompt you would type every Friday becomes the agent's instructions. After that, three words return the same structured recap.

1Say it once — saved as the Weekly Recap agent's instructionsGoalSourceExpectations77 words

Recap my week. Based on my Teams chats and emails, list what has been done this week, grouped by topic. Output a table with Topic – Summary – Next action items. Then look at my calendar for next week and give me a table of the meetings: Topic, the action items I need to deliver for each meeting, and a priority level — whether I have to attend in person or can delegate it to someone else.

2

Then just ask “Recap my week.” — three words, and the agent returns the same two tables.A week later, the same three words — a different week, the same two tables. The structure lives in the agent's instructions.

5.1Agents & next stepsMicrosoftCopilot
Agents

What is an agent? Should I make one?

An agent is a large language model with a harness around it — everything you configure so it does one job the same way, every time.

The harness is what turns a general model into your agent.
Your input“Recap my week.”A prompt, a file, a question
Your outputTwo tables, same structureAn answer, a file, an action
Agent= LLM + Harness
LLMThe engine — reads, reasons and writes
+
HarnessEverything you configure around the engineClick ① and ② to open it3 of 7 shown4 of 7 shownAll 7 shown
Instructions

What to do, and how to answer

Recap: two tables, same order
Knowledge

What it can read

Recap: my emails, Teams chats and meetings
Skills

Know-how it can reuse

Recap: ADARO rules to attend or delegate
Model choice

Which model, and how deeply it thinks

Auto · Quick · Think deeper
Tools & MCPs

Act in other systems

Copilot Studio
Topics

Guided conversation paths

Copilot Studio
Deployment channel

Where people use it

Copilot Studio

Should I make one?

  • Yes — you ask the same thing, the same way, again and again.Like “Recap my week” — the Weekly Recap agent.
  • Yes — your team needs one consistent answer from the same sources.For example, an HSE and SOP procedures assistant.
  • Not yet — it's a one-off question.A good prompt is enough — see Prompting like a pro.
Where to build it
Agent BuilderIn Microsoft Copilot, no code: instructions, knowledge, skills and response mode.
Copilot StudioWhen it also needs tools and MCPs, topics or other channels.

Weekly Recap12/30
Recaps my week from Teams and email, and lists next week's meetings to attend or delegate.
Think deeper

When I say “Recap my week”:

1. This week — from my Teams chats, meetings and emails since Monday, group the work by topic. Table: Topic · Summary · Next action items.

2. Next week — from my calendar, list the meetings. Table: Meeting · Topic · Action items to deliver · Priority — attend in person, or delegate and to whom.

Always these two tables, in this order. If something isn't found, write “Not found” — don't guess.

Your team’s 30-day Copilot plan

Adoption follows the leader. Pick a week to see its habit, tick off what your team has done, and copy the prompt that starts it.

Week 1Make it yours

Apa yang saya lewatkan sejak kemarin? Prioritaskan yang membutuhkan keputusan saya, lalu yang hanya informasi — sertakan sumbernya.

Week 2Lead meetings with it

Apa saja yang sudah diputuskan sejauh ini, siapa pemilik setiap tindak lanjut beserta tenggatnya, dan pertanyaan apa yang belum terjawab?

Week 3Pick team use cases
Start it · Copilot Chat · Work IQ onPremium

Berdasarkan email, chat, dan rapat saya sebulan terakhir, tugas berulang apa yang paling banyak memakan waktu saya dan tim? Sarankan 5 kasus penggunaan Copilot yang paling berdampak, lengkap dengan contoh prompt untuk masing-masing.

Week 4Automate one routine
Start it · Copilot Chat · Work IQ onPremium

Bandingkan cara tim saya bekerja sebelum dan sesudah memakai Copilot bulan ini berdasarkan email, chat, dan rapat: tugas apa yang paling terbantu, apa yang belum, dan 3 langkah berikutnya.
